bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖反弹在 $350 下方回落

read.en: Applied Materials rose 4.2% on Nov 6 to $332.71, trading $329.29–348.71 after opening at $346.15. It remains below the falling 5-day ($355.6), 10-day ($378.9), 30-day ($440.2) and 100-day ($499.3) and the rising 200-day ($445.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, with the histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($415.65), and RSI is 30.5.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月6日上涨 4.2%，收于 $332.71，开盘 $346.15，盘中区间 $329.29–348.71。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$355.6）、10 日（$378.9）、30 日（$440.2）和 100 日均线（$499.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$445.4）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$415.65），RSI 为 30.5。

read.en: The bounce held the $315.7–317 support but faded from $348.7, short of the $350 resistance. Resistance is $348.7–350 (Nov 5–6 highs), then $355.3–359 (Mar 10 and Apr 1 highs, 5-day) and $362.9 (Nov 4 low). Support is $329.3 (Nov 6 low), then $315.7–317 and $311.1. A close above $350 would target $355–363; below $315.7, $311.

s.en: Nov 5 low $316.95; Mar 9 low $316.66; Jan 20 low $315.7
